div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-data-quality-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: The data are assessed as sufficiently representative of the relevant population, setting, or intended use.
The data were subject to measures intended to identify, reduce, and manage errors.
The data are assessed as sufficiently complete for the documented purpose.
The data are assessed as relevant to the documented purpose and intended use.

title.value: EU AI Data Quality Code System

description.value: Codes describing assessed data-quality characteristics relevant to the development, validation, testing, or evaluation of an AI system.
